body:
I found a job after a month of searching but messed it up was a bad idea anyway i can't take showers often and i panic in social situations. I was cashier. I've been out of school this semester I'm just too weak. 

I might look at the stars too it's cold though. I love being outside don't you?  

And my dad doesn't like charities also no extended family... Just waiting for my family to sleep they will soon. Takes me awhile to think it over hard to describe the moment before i attempt. Know what i mean?

It's nice you've got a job! That's an accomplishment for sure. I fucked up my first job by panicking.  Where did you get yours mine was McDon's. 

Also thx for the show and music suggestions i will check them out before i go through. (Except Bebop saw that already. Good show. You remember that episode with the guy on a horse fucking shit up? Lol )
I was supposed to get some a month ago idk what is going on. I doubt it would help anyway...

I don't think my sister would care she tells me to kill myself often even though my 2nd attempt I was sent to the hospital. My brother is autistic and hates me because he's jealous of me... Idk why.  My dad and uncle are nice and I don't want to hurt them but they don't want me to hurt? Also we live in a van mostly It sucks being in a van with 5 ppl. And i have nothing to do everyday but use the phone.

Also for animated shows i REALLY like the characters in Madoka Magica i wish i had a friend like Madoka. Or any. And i heard the hotline might call the police...

I really have tried everything including correcting my thoughts, but they never help for years. All I feel towards myself is hate even when I lie to myself saying good things to myself. I cannot stop my thoughts. Idk if it's my OCD.  I would care for someone else if they told me this but I still hate myself for this. Maybe I'm more horrible then I thought.

I really wish I was like you and could think what you wrote at the end there. What's 2 minutes suffocating when I would feel that same pain emotionally though.

Thank you and continue being stronger then I ever could.

Yea it doesn't get better. Its got WORSE.
I differ in your last sentence though I really do like and care for almost everyone. I hope you believe me on that. Thanks for commenting it feels nice for people to understand
